rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose reflexive when the male antecedent is already clear.

example.jyutping: keoi5 zi6 gei2 zing2 faan1 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when you need to state explicitly that it was him, or to emphasize the subject himself.

example.jyutping: ni1 fung1 seon3 hai6 keoi5 zi6 gei2 se2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that he personally carried out the action rather than someone else.

example.english: The boss handled this complaint himself.
example.traditional: 老闆親自處理呢單投訴。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 can1 zi6 cyu2 lei5 ni1 daan1 tau4 sou3
